name: Rogue (2024)
description: Rogues rely on cunning, stealth, and their foes’ vulnerabilities to get the upper hand in any situation.

weapons: Martial weapons with Finesse or Light property

starting_equipment_options: (A) Leather Armor, 2 Daggers, Shortsword, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Thieves’ Tools, Burglar’s Pack, and 8 GP

1.name: Expertise (Level 1)
1.description: Gain Expertise in two skill proficiencies. (Sleight of Hand & Stealth recommended).

1.name: Sneak Attack
1.description: Once per turn, deal extra damage (starts 1d6, increases with level) on attack with Advantage using Finesse/Ranged, or if ally is within 5ft of target.

1.name: Thieves’ Cant
1.description: Know Thieves’ Cant and one other language.

1.name: Weapon Mastery
1.description: Use mastery properties of 2 kinds of proficient weapons. Change on Long Rest.

2.name: Cunning Action
2.description: Take Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a Bonus Action.

3.name: Rogue Subclass
3.description: Gain a Rogue subclass. (Thief is detailed in Basic Rules).

3.name: Steady Aim
3.description: As Bonus Action, gain Advantage on next attack roll this turn. Can only use if not moved; speed becomes 0 until end of turn.

5.name: Cunning Strike
5.description: When dealing Sneak Attack, forgo Sneak Attack dice to add effects: Poison (1d6 cost), Trip (1d6 cost), Withdraw (1d6 cost).

5.name: Uncanny Dodge
5.description: As Reaction, halve an attacker’s damage against you.

6.name: Expertise (Level 6)
6.description: Gain Expertise in two more skill proficiencies.

7.name: Evasion
7.description: Succeed on Dex save for half damage -> take no damage. Fail -> take half.

7.name: Reliable Talent
7.description: Treat d20 roll of 9 or lower as 10 for ability checks with skill/tool proficiency.

11.name: Improved Cunning Strike
11.description: Can use up to two Cunning Strike effects when dealing Sneak Attack damage.

14.name: Devious Strikes
14.description: New Cunning Strike options: Daze (2d6 cost), Knock Out (6d6 cost), Obscure (3d6 cost).

15.name: Slippery Mind
15.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

18.name: Elusive
18.description: No attack roll can have Advantage against you unless Incapacitated.

19.name: Epic Boon
19.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or other feat. (Boon of the Night Spirit recommended).

20.name: Stroke of Luck
20.description: Turn a failed d20 Test into a 20. Once per Short/Long Rest.
